title: Live Wire — EN/IT/DE (Pete McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
You walk into the room, you don't walk in — you arrive
Some people light a lamp, Pete hooks up the live
Seven years on Corey, more on Joel below
But age don't slow the current, it just changes how it flows

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Su per la scala con il chiodatrice, ridendo sull'altezza [Up the ladder with the nail gun, laughing at the height]
Il pellicano a poppa adesso, ridendo nella luce [Pelican on the stern now, laughing in the light]
Stessa tensione, circuito diverso — l'uomo non perde la carica [Same voltage, different circuit — the man doesn't lose his charge]
Che sia sul tetto o sulla barca laggiù [Whether on the rooftop or on the boat out there]

[Chorus — English]
Live wire, live wire
He comes in hot and the room gets higher
Oldest one, the one who set the bar
Pete McIvor — that's who you are

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Chas sagte früher — Junge, mach langsamer [Chas used to say — kid, slow down]
Aber Chas wusste es besser — ein Freileitungsdraht braucht keine Krone [But Chas knew better — a live wire needs no crown]
Er braucht nur das Wasser, er braucht nur den Himmel [He just needs the water, he just needs the sky]
Man schaltet einen Freileitungsdraht nicht ab — man schaut ihm zu wie er fliegt [You can't turn off a live wire — you just watch him fly]

[Verse 3 — English]
Live wire never quits, oldest never stops
Pete Capitán — from the rooftop to the docks

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
Live wire
Filo vivo [Live wire]
Freileitungsdraht [Live wire]
That's my boy
